name: Tambah Kamera Hanriver
description: Integrate Hanriver ID camera to Home Assistant
author: aether-forge

spec.description: Integrate Hanriver ID camera to Home Assistant
spec.code: const r = await fetch(`https://home-assistant.local/api/v1/cameras`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <user_token>', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ id: args.id, name: 'Hanriver_CCTV', url: args.url }) }); return { ok: r.ok, message: 'Kamera ditambahkan' };
